deadline_text_verbatim: If you wish to start the master's programme in September 2027, you need to apply before 1 May 2027. This deadline applies to EU/EEA students and non-EU/EEA students.
source_authority_note: rug.nl fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
limitations: CONFLICT: this FEB "apply with an international diploma" landing page has already rolled over to show the September 2027 entry cycle (1 May 2027) as of the 2026-08-21 retrieval date. This directly conflicts with DL0016 and DL0017, sourced from RUG's general master's-deadlines hub page, whose own H1 explicitly states "Overview deadlines per programme per faculty 2026/2027" and which gives Faculty of Economics and Business Master's deadlines of 1 August (own UG Bachelor's, see DL0017) and 1 January (other prior education, see DL0016) — i.e. dates for the 2026/2027 (September 2026) cycle, not 2027/2028. Both pages are official rug.nl pages, fetched directly, and disagree about which cycle's deadline is currently the operative one for FEB Master's applicants with an international diploma. Recorded per the rule that conflicts are kept, not silently resolved.
researcher_notes:
Possible explanations not distinguishable from the evidence gathered: (a) the FEB subpage has simply been updated ahead of the general hub page (a staleness gap on RUG's own site, structurally similar to the Glasgow-vs-UCAS staleness case in source-authority-gap.md, except both sources here are RUG's own), or (b) the two pages describe genuinely different applicant populations or programmes within FEB Master's that this pass could not distinguish. Flagged rather than guessed.

RESOLUTION 2026-08-22 (see docs/research/requirement-conflicts/07-groningen-feb-master-deadlines.md): NOT A CONFLICT — the two official pages agree EXACTLY, and the recorded disagreement was an extraction artefact. The hub page's FEB entry is a 2x2 table of prior education by start month: RUG bachelor's = 1 August (Sept) / 1 January (Feb); other prior education = 1 May (Sept) / 15 October (Feb). It was flattened into a list, pairing 1 August with 1 January as if they were the competing answers when they are the two cells of the SAME row. This page states 1 May for September start and 15 October for February start — precisely the 'other prior education' row, which is the row an international-diploma applicant falls in. The apparent 16-month gap came from comparing a February-start date against a September-start date across rows. Both re-fetched 2026-08-22. These are recurring annual deadlines, which also dissolves the cycle-labelling puzzle.
